# Nizam Framework (v2.0.0)

> Development note: v3.0.0 is an unreleased MAJOR corrective candidate. The v2.0.0 pin below is the current published release.

> Nizam is a generalised, AI-legible, versioned governance framework: a single portable payload (`standard/`, `methodology/`, `templates/`, `schema/`, `tools/`, `ecosystem/`, and `NIZAM.json`) that any AI coding agent or engineering team can inherit into any repository, in any runtime, with zero application-code or service dependencies.

Nizam solves four systemic failure modes in agent-driven software engineering:
1. **Context exhaustion** -> solved by **DD-1 (Tool-Driven State Management)**: agents query `NIZAM.json` and read only the minimal governance files a task requires.
2. **Infinite retry loops** -> solved by **DD-2 (Work-Specific Diagnostic Circuit Breaker)**: six failed executions per task and three failures of one signature, with finite step limits and explicit task-scoped operator recovery; successes and continuation labels never reset failures.
3. **Unverifiable chat claims** -> solved by **DD-3 (Evidence Externalisation)**: all proof lives in durable `.agent/` files and cryptographic command receipts under `.agent/evidence/`, never in chat history.
4. **Per-runtime prompt forks** -> solved by **DD-4 (Unified Skill Payload)**: one runtime-agnostic skill (`tools/SKILL.md` + `tools/skill.json`) loaded via `tools/interface.md`.

## v2.0.0 migration and released pin

Existing consumers must follow [Migrating to v2.0.0](https://github.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/blob/v2.0.0/docs/migration-v2.0.0.md): typed inventory before `begin`, assessed structured per-check proof for completion, and finite task-wide retry budgets. The published annotated tag resolves to `603afc7b17919334a6a01df1e39e63798d9d0acd`. The framework's official local self-adoption is recorded separately; each consumer still records its own upgrade authorization. Installed integrity/preflight checks do not establish full consumer commissioning.

## One-Prompt Consumer Onboarding (`v2.0.0`)

Developers can copy and paste this single prompt into any coding agent to onboard a repository to `v2.0.0` (`603afc7b17919334a6a01df1e39e63798d9d0acd`) with minimal friction:

```text
Onboard this repository to the Nizam governance framework (immutable release v2.0.0, commit 603afc7b17919334a6a01df1e39e63798d9d0acd):

1. Read https://niq-cnr.github.io/nizam-framework/llms.txt for the Nizam v2.0.0 AI Agent Entry Protocol and CLI reference.
2. Fetch and run the official bootstrap script pinned to v2.0.0 with commit-bound content verification (never overwrite existing AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, or CI files):
   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/bootstrap.sh -o bootstrap.sh && chmod +x bootstrap.sh
   GOVERNANCE_TAG=v2.0.0 ./bootstrap.sh --tag v2.0.0 --expected-sha '603afc7b17919334a6a01df1e39e63798d9d0acd' --git-repo .nizam-ref/
   ./bootstrap.sh --verify-only --tag v2.0.0 --expected-sha '603afc7b17919334a6a01df1e39e63798d9d0acd' --git-repo .nizam-ref/ --require-content-integrity
3. Query .nizam/NIZAM.json and load .nizam/tools/SKILL.md (resolve paths relative to .nizam/; never edit files inside .nizam/; always set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1).
4. Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 .nizam/tools/start_path.py preflight` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 .nizam/tools/start_path.py status`, then summarize the verified installation and ask what task we should classify first.
```

## AI Agent Entry Protocol (Read First)

1. **Discover the governance root**:
   - Consumer repository (default): `.nizam/NIZAM.json` and `.nizam/tools/skill.json` -> `.nizam/tools/SKILL.md`
   - Framework repository fallback: `NIZAM.json` and `tools/skill.json` -> `tools/SKILL.md`
2. **Classify the task before editing**:
   - Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/start_path.py classify --files <relpath...> --description "<intent>"`
   - Routes: `trivial` | `bugfix` | `small-change` | `standard-feature` | `high-risk`
3. **Gate entry & completion**:
   - Non-feature routes: `tools/start_path.py begin <trivial|bugfix|small-change> --id <id>` and `tools/start_path.py done <trivial|bugfix|small-change> --id <id>`
   - Feature routes (`standard-feature`, `high-risk`): require an approved contract (`.agent/contracts/NNN.json`), pre-code Validator Mode A (`.agent/validator/`), Evaluator contract review (`.agent/qa/`), post-code Validator Mode B, and Evaluator QA verdict.
   - Mechanical contract updates (when goals, invariants, and risk boundaries are unchanged): `tools/start_path.py amend-contract --contract .agent/contracts/NNN.json ...`
4. **Capture & publish receipt-qualified evidence without hidden Git mutations**:
   - `tools/start_path.py preflight` — inspect host capabilities and sandbox adapter readiness
   - `tools/start_path.py capture --step-key <key> --attempt <n> -- <cmd...>` — write exclusive per-execution evidence files without silent overwrites
   - `tools/start_path.py publish` — defaults to noncommitting `--mode prepare` (emits `.publish-request.json`); `--mode publish` requires `NIZAM_MUTATION_ADAPTER` and never falls back to local `git add`/`git commit`; `--mode finalize` verifies committed stage deltas
   - `tools/start_path.py build-receipt` / `verify-receipt` / `resume` / `status`
5. **Never hand-edit `.nizam/`**:
   - Installed `.nizam/` files are immutable and verified byte-for-byte against the pinned release tag via `./bootstrap.sh --verify-only --tag v2.0.0 --expected-sha '603afc7b17919334a6a01df1e39e63798d9d0acd' --git-repo .nizam-ref/ --require-content-integrity`.

## Core Documentation & Index

- [NIZAM.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/NIZAM.json): Machine-readable capability index, routing rules, and module inventory.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/README.md): Human and agent quickstart, start paths, and bootstrap integrity verification.
- [HTML User Guide](https://niq-cnr.github.io/nizam-framework/): Self-contained interactive user guide covering problem/solution, start paths, execution loop, anatomy, modules, and agent integration.
- [llms-full.txt](https://niq-cnr.github.io/nizam-framework/llms-full.txt): Complete consolidated technical reference (all CLI subcommands, 5 start paths, 5 AGF roles, 16 compliance gates, schemas, and ecosystem lifecycle).
- [CONTEXT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/CONTEXT.md): Repository architectural context, module map, and execution commands.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/AGENTS.md): Repository-local agent routing instructions.

## Unified Skill & CLI Tools (`tools/`)

- [tools/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/tools/SKILL.md): Canonical instructions-tier skill payload loaded by any agent runtime.
- [tools/skill.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/tools/skill.json): Machine-readable skill manifest and capability map (version `0.8.2` in lockstep with `SKILL.md`).
- [tools/interface.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/tools/interface.md): Runtime adapter specification (`read-state`, `write-evidence`, `run-verification`, and Section 4.4 external mutation mediation via `NIZAM_MUTATION_ADAPTER`).
- [tools/start_path.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/tools/start_path.py): Task classifier, start-path gate CLI, contract amendment helper, evidence capture/publish pipeline, and status viewer.
- [tools/validate.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/tools/validate.sh): 16-check repository compliance validator (`C1`–`C16` in full sweep; 10 exercised structural checks in `--payload` mode).
- [tools/payload_integrity.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/tools/payload_integrity.py): Trusted commit-bound payload inventory, byte digest, mode, and provenance verifier.

## Standards (`standard/`)

- [standard/AGF.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/standard/AGF.md): Agent Governance Framework — five roles (`Planner`, `Generator`, `Validator`, `Evaluator`, `Orchestrator`), durable state, and machine-parseable verdict rules.
- [standard/GIP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/standard/GIP.md): Governance Inheritance Protocol — immutable SemVer tag pinning, atomic bootstrap, brownfield coexistence, and drift detection.
- [standard/NDS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/standard/NDS.md): Nizam Documentation Standard — YAML frontmatter, version/changelog discipline, and tagged code fences.
- [standard/definition_of_done.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/standard/definition_of_done.md): Eight layered Definition of Done criteria (`Step`, `Handoff`, `Gate`, `Feature`, `Plan`, `Merge`, `Release`, `Ecosystem`).
- [standard/acceptance_bars.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/standard/acceptance_bars.md): Risk-tiered acceptance bars (`Routine`, `Standard`, `High-assurance`).
- [standard/permission_classes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/standard/permission_classes.md): Permission classes (`R0` Read-Only, `W1` Workspace Write, `X1` Local Verification, `M1` Externally Mediated Repository Mutation, `E1` External/Privileged Gate).

## Methodology (`methodology/`)

- [methodology/00_planning.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/00_planning.md): Specification and acyclic feature-list planning protocol.
- [methodology/01_execution.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/01_execution.md): Two-loop contract-first execution harness and right-sized start paths (`trivial`, `bugfix`, `small-change`, `standard-feature`, `high-risk`).
- [methodology/02_adversarial_tdd.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/02_adversarial_tdd.md): Adversarial test-driven verification and `tools/verify_lib.sh` assertions.
- [methodology/03_circuit_breaker.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/03_circuit_breaker.md): Work-specific diagnostic stopping policy, strategy ladder, and bounded decomposition.
- [methodology/04_tool_driven_state.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/04_tool_driven_state.md): Index-driven discovery and externalised `.agent/evidence/` capture.
- [methodology/06_release_train.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/06_release_train.md): SemVer release classification, internal version-anchor closeout, and operator-gated tagging.
- [methodology/10_live_runtime_sessions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/methodology/10_live_runtime_sessions.md): Language-neutral live runtime session protocol (`partially-enforced`).

## Ecosystem Lifecycle (`ecosystem/`) & Schemas (`schema/`)

- [ecosystem/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/ecosystem/README.md): Nine-stage Ecosystem Engineering Cycle (`Bootstrap` -> `Preflight` -> `Baseline` -> `Audit` -> `Plan` -> `Execute` -> `Verify` -> `Promote` -> `Compare`) across `0..n` repositories.
- [schema/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niq-cnr/nizam-framework/v2.0.0/schema/README.md): JSON Schema catalog validating `.agent/` contracts, verdicts, run state, receipts, and ecosystem artifacts.
